verdict.rationale: Docusaurus documents first-class, free Algolia DocSearch integration which is typo-tolerant and relevance-ranked, but this requires applying to/configuring the Algolia DocSearch program rather than being enabled automatically in a fresh scaffold — it's not literally 'out of the box' zero-config search. No community evidence corroborates search quality or confirms it works without setup. Missing for 10: evidence of search enabled by default with zero configuration, independent hands-on confirmation of typo-tolerance/ranking quality, and details on the free built-in fallback (local search) if DocSearch isn't approved.
